productCategories.name: Hat (帽子)
productCategories.description: Headwear, caps, and beanies. Focus on brim and crown texture.

productCategories.description: Handbags, backpacks, and totes. Focus on structure and material.
productCategories.promptConstraint: Maintain the bag's structure (rigid or slouchy). Emphasize leather/fabric grain and hardware details.

productCategories.name: Shoe (鞋履)

productCategories.promptConstraint: Keep the shoe silhouette accurate. Highlight sole texture and upper material.
